record.one_liner: Cloud communications platform with REST APIs for SMS, voice, email, WhatsApp, verification and more.
record.auth_notes: REST calls use HTTP Basic with an API key SID as username and API key secret as password (or Account SID and Auth Token). These are static dashboard/API-created secrets, not OAuth.
record.access_notes: Free trial sign-up with no credit card; trial accounts have limits and pay-as-you-go applies after. Exact trial limits were not checked.
record.api_notes: Docs describe many product APIs (Messaging, Voice, Verify, Lookup, Conversations). The hosted docs MCP is read-only and does not execute API calls.
record.blocker_notes: Self-serve trial sign-up and a documented public REST API. Production use of paid products will be usage-billed.

evidence.quote: To authenticate requests to the Twilio APIs, Twilio supports HTTP Basic authentication. Use your API key SID as the username and your API key secret as the password.
The Twilio REST API is served over HTTPS.
